text_en: A Psalm of David, for the memorial offering.
text_cn: 达味纪念歌。

text_en: O Lord , do not rebuke me in your anger, or discipline me in your wrath.
text_cn: 上主，求你不要在你的震怒中责罚我， 求你不要在你的气愤中惩戒我。

text_en: For your arrows have sunk into me, and your hand has come down on me.
text_cn: 因为你的箭射中了我， 你的手重压了我。

text_en: There is no soundness in my flesh because of your indignation; there is no health in my bones because of my sin.
text_cn: 因了你的盛怒，我已体无完肤； 因了我的罪行，我已粉身碎骨。

text_en: For my iniquities have gone over my head; they weigh like a burden too heavy for me.
text_cn: 因为我的罪过高出我的头顶， 好似重担把我压得过分沉重。

text_en: My wounds grow foul and fester because of my foolishness;
text_cn: 我的创痍溃烂流脓， 完全由于我的愚蒙。

text_en: I am utterly bowed down and prostrate; all day long I go around mourning.
text_cn: 我悲伤得身已伛偻（yǔ lǚ）， 终日行动满怀忧愁。

text_en: For my loins are filled with burning, and there is no soundness in my flesh.
text_cn: 因为我的腰肢焦灼难受， 我的肉体已无完肤。

text_en: I am utterly spent and crushed; I groan because of the tumult of my heart.
text_cn: 我已筋疲力尽，奄奄一息； 我已心痛欲绝，嗟（jiē）叹不已。

text_en: O Lord, all my longing is known to you; my sighing is not hidden from you.
text_cn: 我主，我的呻吟常在你的面前， 我的悲叹不会向你隐瞒；

text_en: My heart throbs, my strength fails me; as for the light of my eyes—it also has gone from me.
text_cn: 我的心颤栗，我的精力衰退， 我眼目的光明也已经消逝。

text_en: My friends and companions stand aloof from my affliction, and my neighbors stand far off.
text_cn: 我遭难时，我的友朋都袖手旁观， 我的亲人都站得很远。

text_en: Those who seek my life lay their snares; those who seek to hurt me speak of ruin, and meditate treachery all day long.
text_cn: 追寻我命的人，张设网罗， 设法害我的人，散布恶谟， 他们要行诡计，日夜思索。

text_en: But I am like the deaf, I do not hear; like the mute, who cannot speak.
text_cn: 但我好像是一个有耳听不见的聋子， 我又好像是一个有口不能言的哑巴。

text_en: Truly, I am like one who does not hear, and in whose mouth is no retort.
text_cn: 我竟成了一个没有听觉的人， 成了一个口中没有辩词的人。

text_en: But it is for you, O Lord , that I wait; it is you, O Lord my God, who will answer.
text_cn: 因为我唯有仰望你，上主， 你必应允我，我主我天主！

text_en: For I pray, “Only do not let them rejoice over me, those who boast against me when my foot slips. ”
text_cn: 我原来说过：“不要让他们洋洋得意， 不要让他们因我的失足而沾沾自喜。”

text_en: For I am ready to fall, and my pain is ever with me.
text_cn: 我生来就易于失足， 因此我常心怀痛苦。

text_en: I confess my iniquity; I am sorry for my sin.
text_cn: 我的确承认我犯了罪愆， 我为了我的过恶而忧惭。

text_en: Those who are my foes without cause are mighty, and many are those who hate me wrongfully.
text_cn: 无故加害我的人，力强凶暴， 无理憎恨我的人，成群结伙；

text_en: Those who render me evil for good are my adversaries because I follow after good.
text_cn: 他们以怨报德而对待我， 因我追求正义而恼恨我。

text_en: Do not forsake me, O Lord ; O my God, do not be far from me;
text_cn: 上主，求你不要舍弃我， 我主，求你不要远离我。

text_en: make haste to help me, O Lord, my salvation.
text_cn: 我的上主，我的救助， 求你速来给我护佑。
